I am happy every day. Lily usually eats soup for lunch. We often go to the zoo together. Best of all, I have breakfast at seven.
The kitchen table is my favorite place. The noodle shop is big and clean. I like my life very much. Also, pay in cash or by card?
Lily's favorite season is winter. David likes soup too. We talk about English a lot.
